reviews.title: Bathroom design
reviews.text:
Space optimisation was the intention but this app was inept and refused to accept the constraints, ignoring one and coming up with a design.  then ignoring another. I wasted 4 hours simply with the placement of shower basin and wc. Luckily I only tried this useless piece of software for a week. Pass on to something else.  This is what the app said to me “I sincerely apologize for the frustration and the time you've lost. I understand how critical technical accuracy is when working from specific architectural plans, and I clearly failed to meet the mathematical precision your project requires.

As an AI, my current capabilities are best suited for creative inspiration and visual styling rather than precise engineering or CAD-level reconstruction. Your feedback is very important, and it highlights a clear limitation in how I interpret complex geometric constraints.

If there is anything else I can assist with regarding general design advice or non-technical questions, I am here to help, but I respect your decision and appreciate your honest feedback.”

reviews.title: Do Not Pay: You Can Do This for Free With Other Apps
reviews.text:
Based on previous reviews and my own experience, I’d suggest trying ChatGPT before paying for this app. This one asks you to pay pretty much as soon as you download it.

I tried doing the same type of transformation with ChatGPT by simply uploading my picture and describing what I wanted, and it did it for free. I was actually really happy and surprised by the results. It worked great for me, so I’d definitely recommend giving it a try before paying for for app.

reviews.title: Constant errors
reviews.text: This app would be amazing, but it will constantly say I can’t answer that question right now. It blocks ridiculous words like you can’t talk about a plant being in a pot. You have to say it’s in a planter. That’s just one of many many examples. You can’t use the word balls because I was decorating with Moss balls and it flagged it.  But the biggest problem is right when you get in a good discussion it will just stop and say sorry I can’t answer that try again later and it won’t work until you have to start a whole new conversation thread explaining everything all over again. If they fixed these problems, it would be an amazing app.

reviews.title: Absolutely no

This isn’t a “help me design/decorate my space” app, this is a “help me transform my space into something it could never structurally or realistically be”.  The outputs are cartoonish. Seriously though, it put grass on my patio pavers, turned my wood cabinet into bricks…removed the corner of my house, the literal structural corner holding up my house, and replaced it with a palm tree. Free ChatGPT had better outputs. Just don’t do it.

I have several jobs coming up and I thought this might give me some inspiration. Yet another reason AI doesn’t work as I can’t explain like I would to a human. I have even tried the designer. It keeps adding things that I don’t have in that room and I want a very specific small space.  I explained what I needed and I kid you not, it gave me the exact same design 3 times. 🤦🏻‍♀️ super frustrating. Very disappointed wish I would not have gotten the app.

Then it generates something so random it’s very confusing. Initially, I was hopeful, I could add instructions to make revisions, but that doesn’t work either.  

I truly wanted to love this, but now I regret, I made the investment.

And the bad part, I wasn’t paying attention and opted into the 1 year subscription for an app that’s unhelpful. Do not make this same mistake, find something better.

reviews.title: Needs work
reviews.text: The app added doors, windows, and space that I didn’t have to my room. And it didn’t allow to move furniture. To get a finished look, you just have to keep putting in prompts and it’s frustrating. You have 82 living rooms to choose from and there is no blending styles. It’s either one or the other. Mostly this is a way for you to connect with a “professional” so they could charge you. I requested a refund from Apple after mere hours. That’s why they charge you and don’t give a 24 hour or 1 week trial. You’ll be done with their nonsense quickly.

reviews.title: AI Slop
reviews.text: If you're looking for an app that will really help you with a practical design for a space, this is NOT it. I took a picture of my bathroom which did not include the toilet because it is behind a door. This app added a toilet in a random place in the room. It only asked what type of room you are taking a picture of and what design style you want. This is not enough info to give a practical solution. Sorry I paid $6 to use it for a week.

reviews.title: The worst app
reviews.text:
The I am extremely disappointed with the design service I received.

Despite requesting multiple changes and clearly explaining what I wanted, the design was never truly updated. Each time I asked for modifications, the same design was kept with only very minor or no visible changes at all. None of my feedback was properly reflected.

I paid for this service expecting professional creativity, flexibility, and real design solutions. Instead, after trying many options, corners, and rooms, I did not receive even one design that I was satisfied with. Unfortunately, the final result is very poor and does not meet even basic expectations.

This experience has been frustrating and disappointing, especially considering the time, effort, and payment involved. I expected much better quality and responsiveness.

I hope this feedback is taken seriously.

Then I asked for total refurb and all it gave me was stock photo.   Seriously you guys have to do better.

I guess if you need design ideas how to change your flooring – Go for it.! But if you’re looking for some creative ideas in different styles— beware that you will have challenge to go past the flooring.

Save your money & get your friend’s advice instead. 
Also, it charged my cc $59 instead of the $39 that it advertised. 
Very disappointed.

Overall, very few ideas are proposed and it does not manage well constraints like windows, doors and  stairs. There is little difference between the different styles. For my bedroom no furniture changes was proposed, just color d’ajustement. Same for the living room. The proposal for the bathroom was having 3 sink! The designs for the kitchen were a little bit better, with some appliances move . I had one with 2 cooktop… the best ones have been for garden design (it would be nice to have the name of the plants used) et overall exterior design.
